title: Les Éclaireurs Lighthouse
visualBrief: Small isolated rough-masonry lighthouse with a red-white-red taper, low recessed wooden door, projecting red gallery lip, delicate black two-rail gallery, black lantern pedestal and domed roof, metal astragals and paired tilted solar panels.

sourceFacts.basis: Provincial tourism publishes11m height. National Argentina tourism photograph supplies the three bands, door, gallery, lantern and small inclined panels. Base diameter and component dimensions are photograph-scaled; mapped exact-QID node8127284556 fixes position.

geographicProposal.notes: The inspected picture supports the red/white/red tapered tower, low door, open black gallery/lantern and bounded rock under its base. Retained mapped node supplies location. Heading0 is an explicitly approximate south-facing doorway and north-facing panels, not a measured bearing. Standard viewer PMTiles are zero at this very small islet and do not resolve its rock. Browser tiers therefore include a bounded roughly10m rock footing rising1.1m above that datum and retain the11m tower height. This is an approximate visual footing, not the complete island or a surveyed tide/focal-height datum.

limitations: Approximate current exterior/facing from the inspected picture and standard viewer PMTiles. A mapped point cannot determine exact door/panel phase; heading0 is explicitly approximate.
Original8320-triangle detailed tower master preserved. Browser derivatives retain tower details and add a bounded roughly10m rock footing because coarse PMTiles do not resolve this small islet.

Four common lime-plaster/painted-metal/wood/weathered-limestone graphs across tiers, plus local glass color. Zero embedded images. Rock extent/base height are interpreted, not complete island reconstruction.
No tide/focal-height datum, bespoke survey, interiors/collision or physical-device timing claim. Footprint replacement remains off.
referenceRights: Original geometry and shared procedural materials. Official photographs are research references only; no reference imagery or third-party mesh is embedded or redistributed.

nativeAxes.front: +Z doorway approximately south; exact door/panel compass phase is not claimed.
nativeAxes.origin: Mapped lighthouse anchor; Y0 standard viewer PMTiles zero datum.

appearance.identity: Compact11m red-white-red taper with recessed low wooden door, open gallery, small black pedestal/lantern, domed roof and paired inclined panels.
appearance.master: Original8320-triangle source preserved exactly in an isolated leaf. Shared parent recipe remains unchanged.
appearance.browser: Far levels retain the full taper, real door recess, gallery, lantern and two panel racks; regular circular subdivisions and rail pickets are reduced. Street/closeup preserve the entire master.
appearance.exclusions: Exact doorway/panel phase, entire rocky islet, birds, tide survey, individual weathering and interiors are excluded. A bounded rock footing is an approximate visualization of the base.

geometrySource: Original component-authored exterior mesh using cited dimensional evidence and separately described photo/map reconstructions. No downloaded mesh, texture or reference image is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under the repository license. Cited sources retain their own rights; OSM-derived axes/footprint evidence © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
materialMethod: Shared canonical material graphs with metric UV repeats in extras.molenSurface; portable glTF PBR factors and vertex colors remain. Dark recesses/lantern panels retain local fallback materials.
reviewStatus: Source geometry ready; fallback/shared renders, maximum fidelity and geographic fit require separate review.
importReason: Keep thin gallery rails, lightning conductors, window reveals and small anchors until a measured LOD chain is reviewed.
